title: SCCM - Hardware Inventory

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (SELECT ResourceID FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers WHERE CollectionID = '${cmcoll}')
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m) AS [Devices],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m JOIN dbo.v_GS_WORKSTATION_STATUS w ON w.ResourceID = m.ResourceID) AS [With hardware inventory],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.v_GS_WORKSTATION_STATUS w WHERE w.ResourceID = m.ResourceID)) AS [Without hardware inventory],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m JOIN dbo.v_GS_WORKSTATION_STATUS w ON w.ResourceID = m.ResourceID WHERE w.LastHWScan < DATEADD(day, -14, GETDATE())) AS [Inventory older than 14 days],
  (SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(mem.TotalPhysicalMemory0), 0) / 1048576.0 AS decimal(12, 0)) FROM dbo.v_GS_X86_PC_MEMORY mem JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = mem.ResourceID) AS [Total RAM GB],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_GS_LOGICAL_DISK d JOIN m ON m.ResourceID = d.ResourceID WHERE d.DriveType0 = 3 AND d.Size0 > 0 AND 100.0 * d.FreeSpace0 / d.Size0 < 15) AS [Disks under 15% free]

panels.title: Disks under 15% free

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ISNULL(cs.Manufacturer0, 'Unknown') AS [Manufacturer],
  ISNULL(cs.Model0, 'Unknown') AS [Model],
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices],
  CAST(AVG(mem.TotalPhysicalMemory0) / 1048576.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) AS [Average RAM (GB)]
FROM dbo.v_GS_COMPUTER_SYSTEM cs
JOIN dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m ON m.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID AND m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_X86_PC_MEMORY mem ON mem.ResourceID = cs.ResourceID
GROUP BY cs.Manufacturer0, cs.Model0
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT
  REPLACE(ISNULL(o.Caption0, 'Unknown'), 'Microsoft ', '') AS [Operating system],
  o.BuildNumber0 AS [Build],
  o.OSArchitecture0 AS [Architecture],
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices]
FROM dbo.v_GS_OPERATING_SYSTEM o
JOIN dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m ON m.ResourceID = o.ResourceID AND m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
GROUP BY o.Caption0, o.BuildNumber0, o.OSArchitecture0
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT TOP 200
  s.Name0 AS [Device],
  d.DeviceID0 AS [Drive],
  CAST(d.Size0 / 1024.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) AS [Size GB],
  CAST(d.FreeSpace0 / 1024.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) AS [Free GB],
  CAST(100.0 * d.FreeSpace0 / d.Size0 AS decimal(5, 1)) AS [Free %],
  d.FileSystem0 AS [File system],
  d.TimeStamp AS [Inventoried]
FROM dbo.v_GS_LOGICAL_DISK d
JOIN dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m ON m.ResourceID = d.ResourceID AND m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = d.ResourceID
WHERE d.DriveType0 = 3 AND d.Size0 > 0
ORDER BY 100.0 * d.FreeSpace0 / d.Size0, s.Name0

SELECT TOP 500
  s.Name0 AS [Device],
  cs.Manufacturer0 AS [Manufacturer],
  cs.Model0 AS [Model],
  cs.NumberOfProcessors0 AS [CPUs],
  CAST(mem.TotalPhysicalMemory0 / 1048576.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) AS [RAM GB],
  o.LastBootUpTime0 AS [Last boot],
  w.LastHWScan AS [Last hardware inventory]
FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_COMPUTER_SYSTEM cs ON cs.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_X86_PC_MEMORY mem ON mem.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_OPERATING_SYSTEM o ON o.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_WORKSTATION_STATUS w ON w.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
ORDER BY s.Name0

description: Hardware inventory from Configuration Manager: models, operating systems, memory and disk space for the devices in a collection.
